trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an elevated error rate (0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — confirmed rolled out successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback. The first attempt timed out, so I verified no incident existed and retried successfully; the on-call engineer was paged.
